proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can alter the held weapon's own form, but the current attachment surface cannot target an item/object for `alter_item_kind`.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
proposed_widenings.justification: Multiple benefits depend on the weapon's current form rather than only on holding it, and encoding them without that state gate would be misleading.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). ... Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item produces deterministic illumination with a specific radius and explicit toggle behavior, which no current effect atom represents.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light

proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff form gains a temporary thrown/ranged weapon profile with explicit ranges, which is not representable by existing passive or activation atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: return_to_hand_after_ranged_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon's immediate return to the wielder's hand after a ranged attack is a deterministic post-attack effect not covered by existing lifecycle or effect atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

notes: Top-level fit exists as a composite magic item, but current surface cannot represent item-form state plus form-gated riders honestly. No content/tracer files were authored.
